paite: Huai khit in hichi ahong hi a, Absalom in kangtalai leh sakolte leh mi sawmnga ama a tai ding in abawlkhol hi.
heading: Absalom Hel Sawmna

paite: Absalom zingkhang in athou a, kulh kongkhak lampi nawl ah ana dingh hi. Thubuai khensak dia kumpipa kiang a hong pai peuhmah ana sam a, "Nang koi khopi a kipan na hia?" ana chi zel hi. Amau, "Na sikha Israel namte lak a khat ka hi,” achi zel uh.
Absalom in, "I aw, na thu ahoih in adik hi. Himahleh angaikhe ding mi kumpipa'n kuamah asep kei," ana chi zel hi.

Absalom mah in, "Michih thubuai gen ding nei hiam, nget ding nei hiam peuhmah ka kiang a ahong paina ding un, gam vaihawmpa in bawl in om leng chi na tel ing e aw! Huchi in diktak in vai ka na hawmsak ding," ana chi zel hi.
Hichi leng ahi lai a, kuapeuh amah zahtakna pe dia hong paitou peuhmah akhut a sawk in alen a, ana tawp hi.
Israel mi kumpipa kiang a thugen dia hong kuan peuhmahte Absalom in huchibang in ana hih zel hi. Huchi in Absalom in Israel mite lungtang aguksak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum li ahong bei in Absalom in kumpipa kiang ah, Hebron a TOUPA kiang a ka thuchiam tangtun ding in hon hohsak in.
"Na sikha in Siria gam a Geshur a ka om lai in Jerusalem a ahon pikik peuhmahleh TOUPA nna ka sem ding, chi in thu ka chiam khinta ngal a," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Khamuangtak in kuan in," achi hi. Huchi in athou a, Hebron ah ahohta hi.
Himahleh Absalom in, “Pengkul ging na zak peuhmah chiang un, Hebron ah Absalom kumpipa ahita, na chi ding uh," chi in Israel nam tengteng kiang ah mi asimsawl khinta hi.
Jerusalem a pan asap mi zanih in Absalom azui uhi. Amau bel lungsim siangtak pu in ahoh ua, thil omdan bangmah athei kei uh.
Absalom in kithoihnate alat lai in Gilon mi Ahithophel, David thudotmi, Giloh a pan athukhak hi. Athusawmguk uh athupi mahmah a; Absalom lam ah lah mipite apung hulhul uhi.
David kiang ah, Israel mite lungtang Absalom lam ah a-awn mahmah, chih thupotu khat in ahong hilh hi.
heading: Jerusalem A Pan David Ataikhia

paite: David in Jerusalem a om, asikha tengteng kiang ah, "Thou unla i taikhe ding uh. Kuamah lah Absalom a pan suakta lou ding i hi ngal ua. Pawtkhe meng un. Huchi lou in zaw ahon pha pah mai dia, i tung uah thil hoih loutak ahon tun dia, namsau in khua ahong sual kha ding," achi hi.
Kumpipa sikhate'n kumpipa kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhate ka toupa, ka kumpipa un aseh peuhmah hih dia mansa ka hi gige uh," achi uhi.
Kumpipa apawt a, a-inkote tengteng in azui uhi. Kumpipa'n inn ngak ding in numei sawm, ameite akoih hi.
Kumpipa apawt a, mi tengteng in azui uh. Gamla kuam mun khat, inn tawpna ah akhawl tadih uhi.
Asikha tengteng in apaikheng ua; Kerit mite, Pelet mite, Git mite, mi zaguk Gath a pan amah hon zuite kumpipa ma ah apai uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa'n Git mi, Ittai kiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia nang na hong tel? Paikik nawn inla, kumpipa kiang ah om in. Nang zaw mikhual gamdangmi leng na hi ngal a, nangmah mun lam ah kik nawn mai in.

Zan zek a hong na hi a, tuni a ka kiang ua asuk atou a hon zui sam ding in ka hon chi ding maw? Ka pai theihtheihna a pai ding ka hi, nang zaw kik nawn inla, na unaute tengteng pikik nawn in. Hehpihna leh thutak na kiang ah om hen," achi hi.
Ittai in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA hinna leh kumpipa, ka toupa ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Kumpipa, ka toupa na omna peuh ah, sih leh sih, dam leh dam, na sikha a-om sam ding," achi hi.
David in Ittai kiang ah, "Pai inla, va galkai in," achi hi. Huchi in Git mi Ittai, amite tengteng leh ataneute tengteng toh agalkai uhi.
Ngaihtak in huai gammi teng akap ua, mipite apai vek uhi. Gamdai lampi zuan in apai ua, kumpipa'n leng Kidron lui akan a, mipi tengteng in leng akan uhi.
Huan ngai in, Pathian thukhun bawm zawng in Zadok leh Levite tengteng akiang ah ahong pai uhi. Pathian bawm anga ua, mipi in khua apawtkhiaksan vek tan in Abiathar ahohtou hi.
Kumpipa'n Zadok kiang ah, "Pathian bawm pen khopi sung ah zawnglut nawn un. TOUPA mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh ahon pikik nawn dia, Pathian bawm leh a-omna ahon musak nawn ding.
Himahleh, nang ah kipahna mahmah ka nei kei achihleh, ngai in, hichi mai ka hi a, hoih asak bangbang in ka tung ah hih mai hen," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n siampu Zadok kiang ah, "Mutheipa na hi kei a hia? Na tapate nih, na tapa Ahimaaz leh Abiathar tapa Jonathan toh lungmuangtak in khopi ah pai nawn un.
Ngai in, kei zaw tanchin ahong theihsak masiah uh gamdai a lui kannate ah ka na om ding,” achi hi.
Zadok leh Abiathar in Jerusalem ah Pathian bawm apaipih nawn ua; huai ah a-omta uh.
Olive tang paitouhna ah David akahtou a, apaitouh ka kawm in akap kawmkawm hi. Alu akhuh a, khevuak in apai hi. Akiang a mi om tengteng in alu uh akhuh chiat ua, kap kawmkawm in apaitou uhi.
Kuahiam khat in Ahithophel, Absalom lam a pang in thusawm mite lak ah apang sam, chih David ahilh hi. David in, "TOUPA aw, Ahithophel lemtheihna haina suaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian biakna tang vum a David akahkhiak touhleh, ngai in, Arki mi Hushai apuanak bohkek silh a, alu a lei kai niaunuau in amah dawn ding in ahong pai hi.
David in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a na hong samleh zaw, kei a ding in puakgik na hi ding.

Himahleh khopi a na kik nawn a, Absalom kiang a, toupa aw, na sikha in ka om ding. Tuma lam a na pa sikha a ka om bang in, tu in na sikha in ka om leuleu ding, na va chihleh Ahithophel lemtheihna hon dalsakpa na hi zaw ding hi.
Huai ah na kiang ah siampu Zadok leh Abiathar leng a-om sam uh ahi kei maw? Huan hichi ahi ding a, kumpipa' inn a thupawt na zak peuhmah siampu Zadok leh Abiathar na hilh zel ding.
Ngai in, atapate uh nih Zadok tapa Ahimaaz leh Abiathar tapa Jonathan leng akiang uah a-om uhi. Na thil zak peuhmahte hon theisak ding in amau na hon sawl zel ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David lawm, Hushai khopi ah alut a; huchi in Jerusalem ah Absalom alutta hi.
